title: Agentic AI Engineer: Building Production-Ready LLM Agents
description: A hands-on, project-based course that takes you from Python-driven LLM API calls to deploying sophisticated multi-agent systems with planning, memory, RAG, and orchestration using LangGraph. You'll build a portfolio of working agents culminating in a deployed capstone application.
audience: Python developers and ML practitioners who want to transition into building, orchestrating, and deploying autonomous LLM-powered agents in production.
